mapper.select: SELECT p.prj_id, p.cntrct_ty_cd, p.use_yn, p.bsn_part_id FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id = #{id}

SELECT h.bsn_part_id, h.aply_bgn_ym, h.rsn_desc, h.chg_user_id, h.chg_at, p.bsn_part_nm AS "partName" FROM prj.prj_part_hist h LEFT JOIN mst.bsn_part p ON p.bsn_part_id = h.bsn_part_id WHERE h.prj_id = #{id} ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_ym ASC
SELECT p.bsn_part_nm FROM mst.bsn_part p WHERE p.bsn_part_id = #{id} AND p.use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT max(c.cls_ym) FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_stts_cd = 'CLOSED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prj.prj_part_hist(prj_id, aply_bgn_ym, bsn_part_id, rsn_desc, chg_user_id) VALUES(#{id}, #{input.aply_bgn_ym}, #{input.bsn_part_id}, #{input.rsn_desc}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT (prj_id, aply_bgn_ym) DO UPDATE SET bsn_part_id = EXCLUDED.bsn_part_id, rsn_desc = EXCLUDED.rsn_desc, chg_user_id = EXCLUDED.chg_user_id, chg_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO sys.data_chg_hist(tbl_nm, obj_rec_id, data_chg_ty_cd, clmn_nm, bfr_val, aft_val, rsn_desc, chg_user_id) VALUES('prj.prj_part_hist', #{id}, 'UPDATE', 'bsn_part_id', #{before}, #{after}, #{reason}, #{actor})
